test_item:
Encryption procedure should be:
(encryption triggered by the special files on the USB drive produces the encrypted pair)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Logdog is enabled on the DUT
3. Private keys are installed on the DUT
4. A USB drive containing __diagSpecialFile and __getSnapshot is inserted into the HU USB port
proc:
1. Confirm the content of /data/vendor/logdog on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/logdog
er: 1. The adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/logdog output lists the encrypted log and the encrypted key
